name: bmb-tech-host
description: Bmb Tech Hosting — WhatsApp bot hosting platform with TX Coins

PAYSTACK_NIGERIA_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Nigeria Paystack public API key (pk_live_...). Leave empty to disable Nigeria payments.

PAYSTACK_NIGERIA_SECRET_KEY.description: Nigeria Paystack secret API key (sk_live_...). Leave empty to disable Nigeria payments.

IMAGE_URL.description: Logo image URL shown in the app header and branding areas

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Google OAuth 2.0 Client ID (from Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials)

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Google OAuth 2.0 Client Secret (from Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials)

SMTP_HOST.description: SMTP host for sending emails (default: smtp.resend.com)

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: E-mail of the super admin account

ABLINER_API_KEY.description: Abliner API key (tsl_live_...) for Tanzania mobile money payments. Leave empty to disable Tanzania payments.

ABLINER_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Abliner webhook signing secret (whsec_...). Required to confirm payments. Webhook URL: https://YOUR-DOMAIN/webhook/abliner
